scope: All 47 inventoried GNU semantic options, their 85 representative spelling/value variants and declared interaction families have routing decisions and default-entry independent GNU oracle checks. This finite inventory does not enumerate infinitely many inputs or guarantee every individual invocation runs faster.

defaultPolicy.denseFilenameProbe: At most 8 files × 4,096 bytes; at least 6 early positive probes selects GNU for eligible filename/content searches. Hints never supply results.
defaultPolicy.ordering: Parallel rg counts, filenames and complete selected lines are buffered and emitted in exact GNU operand/readdir order.
defaultPolicy.absentCompilerOrHelper: GNU fallback; no acceleration evidence awarded.
defaultPolicy.tinyFileProbe: After 32 descriptor sizes, total below 128 KiB selects GNU before walking the remaining tree.
defaultPolicy.textBufferFailure: Bounded record reads and total unpublished payload limit; any malformed/failed/over-budget rg output falls back to original GNU argv before publication.
defaultPolicy.descriptors: Explicit symlink operands, descriptor aliases, stdin, inaccessible inputs and unusual output descriptors retain GNU; caller descriptors are never closed by the dispatcher.
defaultPolicy.longRecordProbe: At most 8 first pages of 4,096 bytes across all lanes; a full page without LF selects GNU before the remaining traversal. Large long-record count/content fixtures are measured losing rg classes.
